name: glideball
title: Glideball
description: Control Glideball, the Mac app for Kensington trackballs.
author: levi_holliday

commands.name: toggle-glideball
commands.title: Toggle Glideball
commands.description: Pause Glideball if it is running, or resume it if it is paused.

commands.name: pause-glideball
commands.title: Pause Glideball
commands.description: Pause Glideball. The trackball works like an ordinary mouse until you resume.

commands.name: toggle-precision-mode
commands.title: Toggle Precision Mode
commands.description: Switch Glideball's Precision mode on or off. It slows the pointer for fine work.

commands.name: set-scroll-mode
commands.title: Set Scroll Mode
commands.description: Choose how the scroll ring feels: Native, Flywheel or Follow.

commands.name: set-pointer-speed
commands.title: Set Pointer Speed
commands.description: Set how fast the trackball moves the pointer, from 0.5 to 80.

commands.name: glideball-status
commands.title: Glideball Status
commands.description: See whether Glideball is on, what it is set to, and today's clicks and distances.

commands.name: check-for-glideball-updates
commands.title: Check for Glideball Updates
commands.description: Open Glideball's software update window and check for a new version.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.


" && exit 1
